name: Price Error Agent
author: Yoda
summary: Watches Australian retail deals and Australia-origin flight feeds for pricing errors, then alerts you to potential bargains.
starterPrompt: Set up alerts for the Australian retailers and flight routes I care about. Include the original listing, current price, and why each alert may be a pricing error.
usageNote: Recheck prices and terms before any purchase. Listings can change, and retailers or airlines may cancel pricing-error orders.
